retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic, industrial-themed layout featuring a large beveled metallic title over a cityscape and a ghostly close-up of eyes.
excludeWhen: organic or hand-drawn styles are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, monochromatic blue-grey composition divided into three horizontal zones: a top section with thin serif text, a middle section featuring a large, beveled metallic logo and a pair of intense eyes, and a bottom section showing a high-angle view of an urban city block.
coreVisualRelationships: The large metallic logo acts as a central horizontal divider between the eyes and the city.
The monochromatic color palette unifies the disparate photographic and graphic elements.
The vertical brushed metal texture is applied consistently across all layers.
The intense gaze in the background creates a sense of surveillance over the city below.
coreInvariants: High-contrast beveled edges on central typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central logo dominates the middle third; eyes occupy the top half; cityscape fills the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the intense eyes, drops to the large metallic logo, and settles on the detailed cityscape at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with texture and detail.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast in the metallic highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and classic roman serif
letterConstructionRules: Central logo uses thick, blocky slab serifs with sharp, angular spurs.
Top text uses a high-contrast, wide-set Roman serif.
All text features a vertical brushed metal texture.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' in the central logo features elongated, sharp outer spurs.
The 'T' has a wide, heavy crossbar that aligns with the top of the other letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy industrial slab serif for the brand name paired with a sophisticated, wide-tracked Roman serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rules framing the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Similar wide-set, small-serif feel for the top text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Sturdy or Impact with custom bevels
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy weight needed for the central logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a monochromatic blue-grey image featuring a close-up of intense human eyes in the top half and a high-angle view of a dense urban city block in the bottom half. Apply a vertical brushed metal texture across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered, beveled metallic slab-serif logo in the middle. Add two lines of wide-tracked Roman serif text at the top, framed by thin horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic blue-grey?
Does the central logo have a distinct 3D beveled effect?
Is the vertical brushed metal texture visible across all elements?
Are the eyes and city clearly separated by the central logo?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the brushed metal texture
Depth of the bevel on the central logo
Tracking width of the top text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical grain is consistent.
Ensure the bevel highlights align with a single light source.
Verify the top text is legible against the eye background.
Confirm the city detail is not lost in the dark shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Urban Metal = (Cityscape + Ghostly Eyes) * Brushed Metal Texture + Beveled Industrial Typography
